column1: # semantics_trees_r2.tsv -- the component list of semantics_trees.tsv (records/semantics-20261116, unchanged there) with the
# anchors of coverage rule revision 2 (kairos/docs/semantics_coverage.md section 8) added to the two components of the
# object-id generation: objid-kinds (file:first-last, the block of the kind constants), objid-kind-type (the declared type
# of the parameter by which a layer function selects its table; the index is found from it, not written here) and
# objid-layer (role:function, roles lookup, create, get, create-finalize, delete-finalize, init, slot-search).  Every other
# field and line is the line of semantics_trees.tsv byte for byte.  The head of the original follows.
# semantics_trees.tsv -- the components of the semantics coverage scan (kairos/docs/semantics_coverage.md) and the anchors of each:
# one line per component version, tab-separated key=value fields.  Keys: label, layer (framework | p0), root, version, headers
# (public headers, globs relative to the root), sources (definition directories, globs), status (status block file:first-last),
# status-types, success, severity (macro names), event-type and run-status (block file:first-last), event-type-types,
# run-status-types, objid (the object-id layer of the generation: lookup,create,delete,init,kind-macro,name-field), p0-source (the
# local copy of C library source text, file:sha256).  Every anchor is resolved by the scan to its file:line and checked.
